core.title: Declare at least one SMOKE acceptance on every WMBT
core.given: Any WMBT plan artifact in the plan: new, edited, or existing and untouched
core.when: the planner authors, edits, reviews or validates it
core.then: Ensure the WMBT declares at least one acceptance whose identity URN has the profile's smoke-acceptance URN shape and whose identity phase is SMOKE.
prefer: Make the SMOKE acceptance the explicit real-infrastructure check between GREEN and REFACTOR.
Repair: resolve the WMBT URN with the profile's URN resolver, open the WMBT plan artifact at the reported violation location, add the SMOKE acceptance, then re-run the rule's check until it is clean.
avoid: WMBTs with no declared real-infrastructure (SMOKE) check.
Assuming downstream SMOKE tests suffice without declaring the acceptance in the WMBT.
Suppressing a WMBT that exercises real infrastructure, or suppressing without an UNTIL expiry.
unless: The WMBT is genuinely docs-only / metadata with no real infrastructure to verify: put the profile's time-boxed suppression marker for this rule on the WMBT's own URN declaration line, with the UNTIL date set to today + 90 days.
core.why: Tester rules only check coverage of SMOKE tests that exist; without a declared SMOKE acceptance the lifecycle has no explicit real-infrastructure verification before REFACTOR.
evidence: Every WMBT plan artifact has at least one acceptance whose identity URN matches the smoke-acceptance URN shape and whose identity phase is SMOKE, or a valid suppression per unless[0]: the WMBT is genuinely docs-only/metadata with no real infrastructure to verify, and the suppression marker for this rule sits on its URN declaration line with an unexpired UNTIL date set to today + 90 days when added.
The stack's check for this rule passes (reports no WMBT without a SMOKE acceptance).
verification: The check counts, per WMBT, the acceptance URNs carrying the SMOKE harness token; a violation is a count of 0. It applies to every WMBT plan artifact, edited or not, and reports the location as the WMBT artifact path and line.
A smoke acceptance is an acceptance URN carrying the SMOKE harness token, in the smoke-acceptance URN shape, with phase SMOKE.

A suppression is honoured only as the inline, time-boxed suppression marker for this rule placed on the WMBT's URN declaration line; the instruction is to set UNTIL to today + 90 days. Whether the WMBT is genuinely docs-only/metadata is a judgement the check does not make.
The check is realized by a stack-specific validator; its id and command are realization details.

values: this rule's check reports a WMBT with 0 SMOKE acceptance URNs

fires: A planner creates a new WMBT whose acceptances are all non-SMOKE harness types.
A planner edits a WMBT and removes or renames its only SMOKE acceptance.
A planner reviews or validates an existing, unedited WMBT that declares no SMOKE acceptance.
The rule's check reports a WMBT declaring 0 acceptance URNs with the SMOKE harness token.
doesNotFire: A WMBT already declares an acceptance with a smoke-acceptance URN and identity phase SMOKE.
A genuinely docs-only / metadata WMBT with no real infrastructure carries an unexpired suppression marker for this rule on its URN declaration line.
Plan artifacts that are not WMBTs (wagon manifests, docs).

neutralityNotes: WMBT, acceptance, SMOKE/GREEN/REFACTOR phases and the identity URN/phase of an acceptance are ATDD methodology concepts, not stack specifics, so they stay in the core. The 'today + 90 days' UNTIL policy is rule policy and stays in the core; only the marker syntax comes from the profile. Severity 3 / disposition suppress-and-clean (from bun.json audit) are recorded in core verification.
